answer: Accredited risk surveyor site report with risk management certification is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. A farm running 479 aliases would need 479 separate proofs, each costing about 92 POA or 14 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. One terrace of signal, one cedar of cost, one yarrow of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
